title: Four active implementation packs still present completed refactors as planning or future work

locations.symbol: planning status and current critical path

observed_behavior: The CSS pack says planning-only and calls styles.queue.css a current 1,827-line file, but the current file has 11 physical lines and imports split children. The Network pack says planning-only and describes networkView.js as about 4,100 lines, but the current parent has 937 physical lines and split child modules. The processing pack calls encode.ps1/remux.ps1 large implementations, but they are 8/13-line wrappers over 11 encode_* and 9 remux_* modules. The Network CSV header says investigation/future work while later phase records say implementation and validation completed through release hardening.
expected_invariant: Active implementation documentation must clearly distinguish historical planning baselines from current architecture and completion status.
root_cause: Completed change packets updated source and embedded phase notes without refreshing pack headers/current-shape sections or moving the packs to an explicitly historical authority class.
failure_scenario: An agent follows active documentation, treats an already split surface as the current monolith, plans duplicate extraction work, selects obsolete owners/validation scope, or mistakes completed Network CSV behavior for future functionality.
evidence: Current exact line counts: styles.queue.css 11, networkView.js 937, encode.ps1 8, remux.ps1 13.
Current process directory contains 11 encode_* and 9 remux_* modules.
Network CSV PREWORK lines 641-835 records completed phases while lines 4-23 retain planning-only/future wording.
All four documents were read completely at their current attested hashes.
existing_safeguards: The packs identify subordinate canonical authorities, source/maps expose current paths, and some later sections retain completion evidence.
safeguard_gap: No active-document semantic status check compares planning headers/current-size assertions with completed packet/source state.
tests_present: Active-document reference and generated-navigation checks cover selected paths and labels.
tests_missing: Canonical status/archive rule for completed implementation packs
Current line-count and owner claim check after refactors
recommended_remediation: Mark each pack completed/historical and update its current-state section, or archive it and point to current canonical architecture and change packets.
remediation_risk: low; documentation-only, with source/architecture verification required
validation_rung: Active-document checks, current path/line/owner census, generated-context checks, and strict packet coverage; real media is not required.
prior_audit_relationship: Fresh independent finding omitted from current W12 first-pass rows; distinct from broken links and stale source-line anchors.

title: Pending Publish fixture inventory assigns Python ownership to a removed app/publish path
observed_behavior: The ownership table names app/publish/pending_*.py, but app/publish does not exist. Current pending_* Python implementation is under src/mediapipeline/core/publish/.
expected_invariant: An active high-risk inventory must identify the existing canonical implementation path and owner.
root_cause: The inventory retained a pre-move flat application path after Pending Publish ownership moved into the core publish domain.
failure_scenario: A reviewer searches a nonexistent owner, overlooks current policy/recovery modules, or places follow-up code into a removed path contrary to AGENTS.md.
evidence: The inventory was read completely at its attested SHA-256.
existing_safeguards: AGENTS.md and MODULE_MAP define core-domain placement, and repository search finds current modules.
safeguard_gap: The inventory provides no moved-path marker or canonical current-directory link.
tests_present: Naming and architecture checks constrain new placement.
tests_missing: Active inventory path-existence and moved-owner validation
recommended_remediation: Replace app/publish/pending_*.py with src/mediapipeline/core/publish/pending_*.py and reconcile owner wording.
validation_rung: Active-document path/reference check, module-map reconciliation, and strict packet coverage; real media is not required.
prior_audit_relationship: Fresh independent moved-path finding omitted from the current W12 first-pass row.
